# Search and filter

## Use when
- The user finds items by typing a query and narrowing by scope, attributes or sort (files, issues, people, products).
- A result list can be filtered by several attributes at once.

## Don't use when
- Choosing from a short known list. Use `Select` or `RadioGroup`.
- Sorting or filtering one table in place. That is the Data table pattern.
- Jumping to a page or running a command by keyboard. A command menu is a separate component (see candidates).

## Decision rules
- The query stays in one `Input` with a search `leadingIcon`, keeps its text after results load, and has a clear control when non-empty. Submit on Enter; do not search on every keystroke unless results are instant. Why: Linear, Slack and Dropbox keep the query visible.
- Scope the results with `Tabs variant="line"` under the query ("All", "Issues", "People") with a result count per tab where known. Why: Linear and Slack scope tabs.
- Sort → one `Select` on the right, default "Relevance". Show the result count next to it ("5 results").
- Few attributes (up to 3) → filter `Select`s in a row. Many attributes → a filter panel (`Sheet` on a phone, side column on wide screens). Why: Amplitude and Selfridges use a filter column; Dropbox and Slack use filter pills.
- Every applied filter appears as a removable `Badge` chip (`removable`, `onRemove`, `removeLabel`), plus one "Clear all" `Button variant="ghost"`. Why: Dropbox "Reset filters", Selfridges "Unselect all filters".
- Results are `ListItem`s (title, one line of match context, metadata) or a `Table` for dense data. Highlight the matched text with the foreground token, not a hardcoded colour.
- No results → echo the query ("No results for 'desig'"), say what to try (check spelling, remove a filter), and offer "Clear filters" `Button`. Why: Linear echoes the query in its empty state.
- Searching → `Skeleton` rows in the shape of results; keep the previous results visible until new ones arrive.
- A failed search → one `Alert variant="danger"` with Retry. Keep the query and filters.

## Components and variants
- `Input` variant: `default` · size: `md`
- `Tabs` variant: `line` · size: `md`
- `Select` size: `md`
- `Badge` variant: `neutral` · size: `md`
- `Button` variant: `ghost`, `outline` · size: `md`
- `ListItem` variant: `default` · size: `md`
- `Skeleton`
- `Alert` variant: `danger` · size: `md`

## Layout and density
- Order: query → scope tabs → sort, count and filter controls → active chips → results. Spacing `--atlas-spacing-3` between controls and `--atlas-spacing-4` between sections.
- Filters in a side column use a fixed width from the content-width token; results take the rest.

## Hierarchy and composition
- The query is the largest control. Tabs scope the same query; they do not start a new search.
- Chips sit directly above the results they describe.

## Responsive behavior
- Phone: query on its own row, tabs scroll horizontally, filters open in a `Sheet` from one "Filters" `Button` that shows the active count.

## States
- default · loading (Skeleton rows) · results · no results (recovery) · error (Alert with Retry) · filtered (chips and Clear all visible).
- empty query: show recent searches or suggestions, not an empty list.

## Accessibility
- The search `Input` has a `Label` or `aria-label`. The result count is announced politely when it changes.
- Chips are focusable with an accessible remove name ("Remove filter Type: PDF"). Sort and filter controls are named.
- Keep focus on the query after clearing filters; move focus to the results heading after submitting.

## Anti-patterns
- Clearing the query when the user changes a filter.
- A "No results" screen with no way out.
- Filters that apply with no visible chip or count.
- Highlighting matches with a hardcoded colour.
- A raw `<select>` for sort.

## Example
```tsx
import * as React from "react"
import { Search } from "lucide-react"
import { Alert } from "@atlas/ui-web/compositions/Alert/Alert"
import { ListItem, ListItemContent, ListItemDescription, ListItemTitle } from "@atlas/ui-web/compositions/ListItem/ListItem"
import { TabsList, TabsRoot, TabsTrigger } from "@atlas/ui-web/patterns/Tabs/Tabs"
import { Badge } from "@atlas/ui-web/primitives/Badge/Badge"
import { Button } from "@atlas/ui-web/primitives/Button/Button"
import { Input } from "@atlas/ui-web/primitives/Input/Input"
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@atlas/ui-web/primitives/Select/Select"
import { Skeleton } from "@atlas/ui-web/primitives/Skeleton/Skeleton"

type Result = { id: string; title: string; context: string; type: string }

export function SearchResults({ results, loading, error, onSearch, onRetry }: {
  results: Result[]
  loading: boolean
  error: boolean
  onSearch: (q: string, scope: string, sort: string, filters: string[]) => void
  onRetry: () => void
}) {
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("")
  const [scope, setScope] = React.useState("all")
  const [sort, setSort] = React.useState("relevance")
  const [filters, setFilters] = React.useState<string[]>([])
  const run = (q = query, s = scope, so = sort, f = filters) => onSearch(q, s, so, f)
  // One chip per attribute: choosing a value replaces that attribute's chip, "any" removes it.
  const setAttr = (attr: string, value: string) => {
    const next = filters.filter((x) => !x.startsWith(`${attr}: `))
    if (value !== "any") next.push(`${attr}: ${value}`)
    setFilters(next); run(query, scope, sort, next)
  }
  const attrValue = (attr: string) => filters.find((x) => x.startsWith(`${attr}: `))?.slice(attr.length + 2) ?? "any"

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: "var(--atlas-spacing-4)" }}>
      <form role="search" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); run() }}>
        <Input aria-label="Search" type="search" leadingIcon={<Search aria-hidden size={16} />}
          value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} />
      </form>

      <TabsRoot variant="line" value={scope} onValueChange={(v) => { setScope(v); run(query, v) }}>
        <TabsList aria-label="Search scope">
          <TabsTrigger value="all">All</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="issues">Issues</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="people">People</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>
      </TabsRoot>

      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--atlas-spacing-3)", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
        <span aria-live="polite">{loading ? "Searching…" : `${results.length} results`}</span>
        <Select value={sort} onValueChange={(v) => { setSort(v); run(query, scope, v) }}>
          <SelectTrigger aria-label="Sort by"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="relevance">Relevance</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="newest">Newest</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="oldest">Oldest</SelectItem>
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--atlas-spacing-3)", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
        {([["Type", ["PDF", "Image", "Doc"]], ["Status", ["Open", "Closed"]]] as const).map(([attr, values]) => (
          <Select key={attr} value={attrValue(attr)} onValueChange={(v) => setAttr(attr, v)}>
            <SelectTrigger aria-label={attr}><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="any">{attr}: Any</SelectItem>
              {values.map((v) => <SelectItem key={v} value={v}>{attr}: {v}</SelectItem>)}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        ))}
      </div>

      {filters.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--atlas-spacing-2)", flexWrap: "wrap", alignItems: "center" }}>
          {filters.map((f) => (
            <Badge key={f} variant="neutral" removable removeLabel={`filter ${f}`}
              onRemove={() => { const next = filters.filter((x) => x !== f); setFilters(next); run(query, scope, sort, next) }}>
              {f}
            </Badge>
          ))}
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => { setFilters([]); run(query, scope, sort, []) }}>Clear all</Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {error ? (
        <Alert variant="danger" title="Search failed" description="Your query and filters are kept."
          actions={<Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onRetry}>Retry</Button>} />
      ) : loading ? (
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: "var(--atlas-spacing-2)" }}><Skeleton /><Skeleton /><Skeleton /></div>
      ) : results.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: "var(--atlas-spacing-3)" }}>
          <p>No results for “{query}”.</p>
          <p style={{ color: "var(--atlas-foreground-muted)" }}>Check the spelling, or remove a filter to widen the search.</p>
          {filters.length > 0 && <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => { setFilters([]); run(query, scope, sort, []) }}>Clear filters</Button>}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ul style={{ display: "grid", gap: "var(--atlas-spacing-2)", listStyle: "none", padding: 0 }}>
          {results.map((r) => (
            <ListItem key={r.id} as="li">
              <ListItemContent>
                <ListItemTitle>{r.title}</ListItemTitle>
                <ListItemDescription>{r.context}</ListItemDescription>
              </ListItemContent>
            </ListItem>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```
